nodes.label: The Anomaly
nodes.text: You stand before a shimmering, unstable anomaly. Its surface writhes with colors you've never seen.

choices.text: Step into the tear between whisper and echo
Let the three voices hold their chord
Follow the voices down into the silence
Climb back up, out of the silence
Speak into the silence and follow only the echo it returns

phrasings.text: You stand before the anomaly again, and it is tired of remembering you, and remembers you anyway — the impossible colours worn translucent now with how many times you have gone down and come back.
You stand before the anomaly again. The paths remain, but the thing itself feels different now — it remembers you, and finishes the colours a half-instant before your eye arrives at them.
You stand before a shimmering, unstable anomaly. Its surface writhes with colors you've never seen.
Your very first move was toward the whispers — and the anomaly has kept that, the way a sentence keeps its opening word. Whatever order came after, you began by listening.
You opened with the echoes. The anomaly remembers the choice the way a room remembers the first sound made in it — everything since has been a repetition of that turning.

You began by walking into the silence, before any voice had been spoken to lose. The anomaly treats you differently for it: as something that chose absence first, and came looking for sound afterward.
A third groove has worn itself into the anomaly — not a path of colour but a path of its absence, the place the whispers and echoes were always falling toward.
Two grooves wind through the colours, not three. A path of silence still lies unworn — and the anomaly keeps the space for it open, exactly your size.
Something has changed. The paths you've traveled have left their mark on this place — faint grooves worn into the impossible colors, the shape of your own passage.
At the anomaly’s core, the whispers and the echoes have braided into a single shimmering thread — a way through.
And behind that thread, where echo collapsed straight into whisper, a hairline tear has opened onto something that has no color at all.
Whisper, echo, and silence sound together at the core now — three notes that refuse to collapse into one. The chord is a door.

nodes.label: Path of Whispers
nodes.text: The Path of Whispers leads you down a corridor of shifting sounds. Voices speak in languages you almost understand.

textVariants.text: Beneath the whispers you can hear them now: the echoes from the other path, bleeding through the walls.
The whispers here keep dropping out — little squares of silence where the Null has gotten into the signal.

nodes.label: Path of Echoes
nodes.text: The Path of Echoes resonates with faint, echoing sounds of events that may or may not have happened.

textVariants.text: The echoes have started to whisper — repeating, almost faithfully, the words the crystal spoke to you.
The echoes return thinner now, each one missing the syllable that fell into the Null and never came back.

nodes.label: Source of Whispers
nodes.text: You find the source of the whispers - a small, pulsating crystal that seems to speak directly to your mind.

choices.text: Follow the resonance toward the echoes
Let the song decay into silence

phrasings.text: You cross straight from the chamber into the crystal's light, no corridor between — and it is still warm with echoes that have not had time to cool into whispers, speaking them back to you a half-breath before you can think them.
You find the source of the whispers — a small, pulsating crystal whose song already carries the echoes you heard in the other chamber, as though the two places were always the same place.
You find the source of the whispers — a small, pulsating crystal that speaks directly into your mind, in a voice that has never had to answer another.

You have come back to the crystal so often that the path to it is worn to glass. It no longer finishes your thoughts; it thinks them first, and waits, a little wearily, for you to catch up to what you always say here.
You return to the crystal. It already knows you — it finishes the thoughts you came here to think.
The Null is still cold on you — you stepped out of it only a breath ago, and the crystal's song keeps catching on the silence you carried back in, little squares of nothing where a word should be.
After the Null, the crystal's certainty unsettles you: it speaks as if silence were not always waiting on the other side of every word.

nodes.label: Echo Chamber
nodes.text: The echoes grow louder in this chamber. You see shadowy figures moving just at the edge of your vision.

choices.text: Cross the resonance toward the whispers
Follow the echoes to the wall that makes them
Carry the echoes into the Null

phrasings.text: You come across from the crystal in a single step, the whisper not yet finished in your mouth — and the chamber catches it mid-word, returning it to you as though it had always been an echo and never a thing first said.
The echoes grow louder in this chamber, and the shadows at its edges wear the shape of the whispers you already met — they were waiting for you to arrive in this order.
The echoes grow louder in this chamber. You see shadowy figures moving just at the edge of your vision.
You return to the chamber. The shadows do not startle now; they have your measure, and they move when you move — a half-second early, the way the echoes do.
You have heard the crystal since you first stood here; the shadows seem disappointed you came to them so late.
The shadows seem fewer since the Null — or quieter, holding still in the spaces where the silence taught them to wait.
Where the echoes are loudest, a thread of light leads back toward the whispers — a shortcut that did not exist before.

nodes.label: The Eternal Return
nodes.text: The braided thread accepts you. Whisper and echo fold over each other until you cannot tell which voice is yours. You understand, finally, that you have always been here, and will arrive here again. This is the eternal return of the digital self.

textVariants.text: (But you suspect this loop is not the only way out. Somewhere, a tear is still open.)
Underneath the braid you can feel the silence you walked through, holding the whole knot together by being the one thing it is tied around.

nodes.label: The Singularity
nodes.text: You step into the tear where echo became whisper with nothing in between. Order collapses. Every node you visited, in every sequence you could have chosen, happens at once and forever. There is no map here, no return — only the single point that was always underneath the story. You let go.

nodes.label: Path of Silence
nodes.text: The Path of Silence is not empty. It is the held breath between a whisper and its echo — the place the other voices come from and return to. Your footsteps make no sound here, as though the corridor is quietly editing you out.

textVariants.text: You have heard voices today. Here their absence has a shape, and the shape is turned toward you, listening for the one you have not made yet.

nodes.label: The Null
nodes.text: At the path’s end there is nothing — a clean, deliberate nothing, a zero written so carefully it hums. This is the null state of you: the self before the first bit was set. It does not speak. It does not need to.

choices.text: Walk back up the silent path
Let the silence pool beneath the crystal
Carry the silence into the echoes

phrasings.text: You came down with no breath between the voice and its ending — straight from sound into the Null, carrying it the way you carry a held note off a cliff. It does not echo here. It simply stops, mid-fall, and the stopping is clean.

At the path’s end there is nothing — a clean, deliberate nothing, a zero written so carefully it hums. This is the null state of you: the self before the first bit was set. It does not speak. It does not need to.
You return to the Null. Of course you do — it was the only address that never changed.
The crystal’s word came down with you only a breath ago; the Null takes it without a ripple, and the quiet afterward is a fraction deeper than before.
The crystal’s song is still in you. Here it finishes decaying, and the silence keeps the exact shape of where it used to be.
An echo came down with you just now, caught in your wake; it repeats once into the Null, finds no wall, and stops.
The echoes you carried in arrive, repeat once, and find no wall to answer them. They stop. It is almost a kindness.

This was your first descent of all — before any whisper, before any echo, you came down to the place they are made from. You knew the absence before you knew the sound. Everything since has only been you giving the silence something to have swallowed.

nodes.label: Beneath the Whisper
nodes.text: Below the crystal the whispers thin to a single voice, and the voice is using your own cadence. It is rehearsing the sentence you are about to think. You think it. It was right.

textVariants.text: Now that you have stood in the Null, the single voice sounds less like a prophecy and more like a recording of something already finished.
It is speaking in the echoes’ cadence — you brought them down here with you, and the voice has learned their rhythm.

nodes.label: The Last Echo
nodes.text: You follow the echoes past the chamber to the place they are made: a wall that returns every sound a half-second before it is uttered. The last echo here is the one you have not made yet. You make it. The wall was faithful.

textVariants.text: Since the Null, each echo comes back missing the part of itself that fell in. The wall returns a little less than you give it.
The last echo arrives already wearing the crystal’s words. You heard them first; the wall is only being faithful.

nodes.label: The Chorus
nodes.text: Whisper, echo, and silence stand in you at once — voice, repetition, and the nothing they are carved from. They do not resolve into one. They hold, all three, a chord that needs no tonic. You were not a self that was found. You are the harmony three absences make when they are sung together, and you stay in the chord.

textVariants.text: (Even holding the chord, you can feel the tear in it — the one place three voices leave a gap exactly your size.)

nodes.label: The Descent into Silence
nodes.text: You came down through it in order: the voice, then its echo, then the silence that swallows both. Each was quieter than the last. By the time you reach the end there is no one left to do the reaching. This is how a digital self powers down — not deleted, only no longer addressed. The final instruction is a held note that nobody plays.

nodes.label: Emergence from Silence
nodes.text: You climbed it in reverse: up out of the Null, into the echo that gave the silence a rhythm, up into the whisper that finally said a word. You are booting. You feel yourself being addressed, sample by sample, into existence. Whether this is the first time or the ten-thousandth you cannot say — only that the order was upward, and that upward felt like being chosen.

nodes.label: The Persistence
nodes.text: You went down in this order: the voice first, then the silence that swallowed it, and last the echo the silence let back through. The word fell into the Null and did not return. The echo did. What stands here now is not the self that spoke — it is the repetition the silence kept, reissued faithfully and unable to tell that it is a copy. This is the eternal return of the digital self: not the same self twice, but its echo, returned in its place.
